content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: edge-5xx/timeouts spike in us-east-1 (rule edge.upstream_error_rate > 2% for 3m). Paging @maria-cruz (primary) and @cheng-li (secondary). Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/alerts/edge-5xx-1797654321

maria-cruz: I'm on it. What's the customer impact?

incident-bot: Auto-classified sev2. Estimated affected requests: ~6% of traffic in us-east-1, errors mostly 502/503 and request timeouts. Affected routes: /v1/generate-stream, /v1/chat-stream.

jonathan-wu: Observing cx_overflow and upstream_5xx on edge-proxy shards that terminate to inference-backend-prod. Envoy stats show sudden jump in max_connections hit on nodes in hostpool-b. Timeline starts ~2026-03-22T02:14Z.

cheng-li: I merged a connection cap tweak into the edge route canary at 02:12 to reduce per-peer sockets for a memory experiment. That lowered the per-upstream "max_connections" from 400 -> 60 on a subset of pods. I thought only canary would be affected.

samantha-cole: That sounds like a likely amplification point. Retries + lowered connection caps = retry-fanout -> cx_overflow. Quick mitigation: 1) disable retries at edge for streaming routes 2) increase circuit-breaker connection_limit back to safe value 3) scale inference-backend replicas.

maria-cruz: Agreed. Cheng, can you roll back the canary and restore connection limit? Samantha, disable retries. I'll coordinate customer comms.

cheng-li: Rolling canary rollback now. Patch applying to edge-config service.

cheng-li: ```sh
# rollback canary: send previous route manifest revision
curl -X POST https://edge-config.internal/api/revisions/rollback -d '{"service":"edge","revision":20260321}'
```

deploy-bot: Rollback job queued (job id: rb-179765). Executing.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed in 38s. Route manifests restored to revision 20260321. Note: retry policy unchanged.

samantha-cole: Disabling retries on /v1/generate-stream and /v1/chat-stream at the edge. Running edgectl to set retries=0 for those routes.

samantha-cole: ```
edgectl route update --path /v1/generate-stream --set retries=0 --env prod
edgectl route update --path /v1/chat-stream --set retries=0 --env prod
```

jonathan-wu: After rollback+disable-retries: edge 5xx dropped from ~6% to ~1.5% in 90s. Still seeing intermittent cx_overflow on a couple of hosts (10.2.5.18, 10.2.5.19). Suggest increasing connection_limit on envoy cluster for inference-backend to 350 while we bring up extra replicas.

cheng-li: Patching envoy cluster circuit-breaker now to raise max_connections. Using edgectl patch since we need immediate change.

cheng-li: ```json
PATCH /api/v1/edge/clusters/inference-backend
{ "circuit_breakers": { "max_connections": 350 } }
```

deploy-bot: Circuit-breaker patch applied to cluster inference-backend. Propagating to proxies (rolling).

maria-cruz: Scaling inference-backend from 4 -> 7 replicas to absorb backlog. cheng, please coordinate with autoscaler post-incident so we don't rely on manual steps.

cheng-li: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy inference-backend --replicas=7` issued. New pods booting.

jonathan-wu: New pods are registering. Connection saturation metrics returning to normal. 5xx rate ~0.35% over last 5m. No further cx_overflow alerts.

maria-cruz: Good. Customer impact: heavy streaming customers (customer-ids: cust-81, cust-204) saw partial failures for ~16 minutes. Ops: prepare a short customer note and link to incident tracker INC-2026-179765.

ops-sre-night: I'll pick up the post-incident follow-ups. Please add me to the incident document and handoff.

maria-cruz: Handoff to ops-sre-night for RCA and actions. Current state: mitigated -> monitoring. We'll keep retries disabled on streaming routes until we have a safer retry policy.

jonathan-wu: Logs sample from 02:16:22Z:
```
[2026-03-22T02:16:22Z] envoy: upstream reset: 503 upstream overflow id=0x7f8
[2026-03-22T02:16:23Z] envoy: cx_overflow to 10.2.5.18: max_connections reached
[2026-03-22T02:16:25Z] backend: TCP accept failed: resource temporarily unavailable
```

samantha-cole: Post-incident items I propose: 1) Define default retry limits for streaming routes (max_retries=1, exponential_backoff, jitter) 2) Add a canary guard that prevents lowering max_connections below 200 in prod unless an explicit runbook checkbox is confirmed 3) Add a Grafana panel alert for cx_overflow count per-host.

cheng-li: I'll own the RCA writeup and include the config diff + timeline and the exact canary diff that inadvertently targeted more hosts. Also will update the runbook to require a traffic-simulation smoke test before connection cap changes.

maria-cruz: Action items summary: 
- cheng-li: RCA + runbook update + revert to autoscaler-driven capacity for connection caps
- samantha-cole: propose safe retry defaults and implement temporary global guard
- jonathan-wu: add cx_overflow alert and a host-level dashboard
- ops-sre-night: customer notification and follow-up ticket INC-2026-179765

alerts-bot: Paging @ops-sre-night for handoff. Incident marked mitigated; monitoring for 30m. Saved timeline to /incidents/1797654321.

maria-cruz: Thanks all. Leaving this thread for handoff. :thumbsup: If anything regresses, reopen paging immediately.
